text_block_list.text: It was a bright and sunny day in front of the Miho Dormitory—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Alright! Let's get this watering wrapped up in no time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Now then, hose, hose... huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: *sigh* Someone swapped the hose for a toy snake again.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
W-W-Wait a sec—!!
Why, nodda?!
Why aren't you surprised, Hishiama?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haha, I knew it was you, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: When you do the exact same thing every single time, everyone's bound to get used to it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: NO WAAAAY!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
T-That's impossible, nodda!
Everyone is supposed to get terrified of Windy-chan's pranks, noddaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bwah!!
Windy-chan has invaded, nodda~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Are you asking for a high-five?!
Let's do it, let's do it~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nyahahaha!
I swapped your Japanese textbook with one for elementary schoolers, nodda!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Wow, how nostalgic! I really loved the story about the horse girl aiming to become a soccer player.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I floated a ton of rubber duckies in the pool, nodda!
Everyone's gonna be super shocked by this, nodda!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wahhh~! So many ducks!
Alright, let's swim together~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Why, nodda... Not only is nobody surprised, but they're actually looking all relaxed and soothed, nodda...!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: —You know, doing something different once in a while is pretty important~.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Totally! Even if it's a routine you're good at, doing the exact same thing over and over gets so repetitive and boring.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: When you do the exact same thing every single time, everyone's bound to get used to it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: C-Could it be that Windy-chan's pranks... have gotten into a rut too?! They're underestimating me, nodda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: If that's how it is, I'm gonna pull off the biggest prank ever that'll make even Hishiama tremble in fear, nodda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
With Windy-chan's flawless grand scheme,
I'll blow everyone completely away, nodaaaa!!

As Shinko Windy declared proudly, her eyes were
filled with sheer ambition, radiating a shine
reminiscent of an overlord of evil.
